channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Paul Martin and experts Mark Stacey and David Fletcher visit the Dorford Centre in Dorchester. A lady brings in the last of her pin cushion doll collection for David's attention and Paul takes a look at a Royal Doulton Black Jack. The star item of the day is an old globe found by Mark which proves to be a big hit at the auction.
